rationale: PINS the SCD4 contract (M37 #598): a throw's References target must be a NAMEABLE type. `throw new IllegalArgumentException(...)` previously embedded the ENTIRE construction — raw text including the message argument (`new IllegalArgumentException("negative: " + x)`) — as one unmatchable graph node. Now: construction throws reference the exception type; bare-identifier throws (throw ex) reference the identifier; non-exception throws emit nothing (no nameable target). The instantiates edge for the construction stays (separate collector).
